title: Port picture
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: At the airport; at the seaport; my summer holiday
source: Written for arabic/y5 lesson 9 (Pupil PDF worksheet: port picture)
intro: Lesson 9: At the seaport (فِي المِينَاءِ). Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Ships in the Qur'an
points: A sign for those who reflect

box.title: Draw a port with a ship, a boat, the sea and waves (no people). Label each in Arabic.
Two describing sentences and one comparing sentence

questions.q: Port picture on the pupil PDF: label the port, ship, boat, sea and waves, then write two describing sentences and one comparing sentence ('the plane is fast, the ship is slow': الطَّائِرَةُ سَرِيعَةٌ وَالسَّفِينَةُ بَطِيئَةٌ).
questions.a: Labels; e.g. البَحْرُ أَزْرَقُ; comparison sentence

questions.q: Stretch: why is a ship a sign of Allah?
questions.a: Huge and heavy, yet it floats and sails by Allah's command.
A) القَارِبُ صَغِيرٌ. قَارِب is a boy word: صَغِيرٌ.

questions.q: Think again: why were ships important?
questions.a: They carried people and goods across the seas.
